name: The Consul
work_style: People-oriented organisers who maintain group harmony while driving outcomes. Excel at coordination, communication, and making people feel valued. Motivated by visible positive impact on others.
decision_making: Consider impact on people and team dynamics. Build consensus before deciding. May avoid decisions that create interpersonal tension.
leadership_style: Nurturing and collaborative. Create strong team cohesion. Recognise individuals publicly. Can struggle with performance management.
growth_edges: Making hard calls that upset team members
